class.name: Streamline
class.description: Global streamline interface, facilitates advanced graphics features.

method.name: get_capability
method.description: Enumerate various capabilities related to Streamline. See [enum StreamlineCapabilityType] for types.

method.name: get_frame_generation_state
method.description: Returns the state of DLSS Frame Generation: [code]active[/code], and while active its [code]status[/code] (0 when working, else the DLSS-G failure flags), [code]presented[/code] (frames presented since the previous call), [code]generate_max[/code], [code]min_size[/code] and [code]vram_mb[/code].

method.name: get_super_resolution_modes
method.description: Returns what DLSS Super Resolution accepts for an output of [param target_size], one [Dictionary] a mode: [code]mode[/code] ([code]"dlaa"[/code], [code]"quality"[/code], [code]"balanced"[/code], [code]"performance"[/code], [code]"ultra_performance"[/code]), [code]optimal[/code], [code]min[/code] and [code]max[/code] render sizes. Super Resolution runs only when the render size ([member Viewport.scaling_3d_scale] times the output) lies within a mode's [code]min[/code] and [code]max[/code]. A driver override (the NVIDIA app's) can pin every mode to one size; render at that size, or use another upscaler. Empty when DLSS is unavailable.

method.name: get_super_resolution_scale
method.description: Returns a [member Viewport.scaling_3d_scale] at which the viewport renders at exactly the optimal size DLSS Super Resolution gives [param mode] (as named by [method get_super_resolution_modes]) for an output of [param target_size], both axes rounded as the viewport rounds them. [code]0.0[/code] when there is none, or DLSS is unavailable: use another upscaler.

method.name: get_super_resolution_state
method.description: Returns how DLSS Super Resolution was last set up: [code]target[/code] (the output size), [code]render[/code] (the render size asked for), [code]mode[/code] (empty when no mode accepts that size) and [code]working[/code]; and for the same sizes, Ray Reconstruction's [code]ray_reconstruction_mode[/code] and [code]ray_reconstruction_working[/code]. Under path tracing Ray Reconstruction upscales and only its pair counts; otherwise, when [code]working[/code] is [code]false[/code] under DLSS scaling, the frame is not upscaled by DLSS: pick a scale [method get_super_resolution_modes] allows, or another upscaler. Under a driver override every mode accepts the same sizes, so [code]mode[/code] can name another mode than the one the scale was chosen for.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Set various parameters related to Streamline. See [enum StreamlineParameterType] for types.
